findings.detail: release/certified-scientific-fingerprint.json names campaign sha256:ad393bc0fc36df108c0b93e3a0cc35bc175b34fb00788f3306dbee707d467eb7, climb sha256:ac76d7876dafbdc3bcddf4884dfa75831eff3a1ad461de517d4f04ef29a3e4fa, catalog sha256:ae300ef6ba97233f5bef86b8281ed34a02db91114d8d78c79324ce68f721d386 and engine sha256:874cbae03d39358297685e55963d08f455cc5ca2255c928dd5f2ffdd98e69bd8. This wheel ships a later lineage: campaign sha256:ebf029abb266ca74c2def50eb23030511bab0e929c6bf4a68691f9b5afd554b1, climb sha256:a3a5e9c5f9b40d4f08fad54852377e201fd0d6dd4acfa4c565a0edfac324a236, catalog sha256:10a7fcc5de1951c14509947c0512a4eeb247a703cdf01cc3f268580979a7d12c, engine sha256:29b1bbb8327d8f1a9ade03ff4504695ad3783ae34aaaa559e5c6bf9fc95e879b. The budget contract that file certifies is byte-for-byte the same in the shipped Campaign — 44 model calls, 900000 input tokens, 16000 output tokens, 600s rollout timeout, $2.5 maximum — so the shipped bytes carry the recertified contract, but the fingerprint document has not been re-pointed at the digests this wheel actually contains. This inspection records the divergence and does not resolve it.

release_contract_note: The packaged ReleaseCore is a contract: every coordinate in it is one a person chose, and it describes no artifact of its own (decision 0026). This wheel's identity is the stamp above, written during the build and absent from the committed tree.

wheel.built_from: a clean clone of commit 5d793b699ce75779269a67a7c2f0d9cc9c6b79de, built with `uv build --wheel`. The commit is not asserted here: the build hook (tools/stamp_provenance.py) asked git which commit the packaged sources are and refused to write a stamp for anything else, and the stamp read back out of the wheel is the value recorded above (decision 0026 section 2).
wheel.member_count_note: 161 members: 156 payload plus the 5 dist-info files. One payload member more than the previous inspection of this package — techtree/cli/confirm.py now ships. Comparing `git ls-tree -r` over src/techtree at the commit that inspection read (8d9068cfca818d3ae39f7ea130a90f596b33d4f5) and at this freeze commit shows that one file as the only difference between the two packaged source trees.

reproducible.detail: NOT re-observed by this inspection. The two-clean-clone double build of 5d793b699ce75779269a67a7c2f0d9cc9c6b79de was performed by the orchestrating session before this record was written and was not repeated here, so this inspection makes no first-hand reproducibility claim. What this inspection did read for itself: the wheel in dist/ hashes to sha256:e486b3eaa477455566035f9b210db824e1bdda765b1ade0f44891da6b2c855c2, the provenance stamp inside it names 5d793b699ce75779269a67a7c2f0d9cc9c6b79de, and tools/verify_release_core.py — run against this wheel and the staged bootstrap document — passes all 26 checks, including bootstrap_cli_wheel_sha256 and bootstrap_cli_source_revision.
